1. Standard Digital Incorporation Timelines (3-24 Hours)

Under standard operating conditions, registering a UK Private Limited Company (LTD) digitally with Companies House takes between 3 and 24 hours during normal business days (Monday through Friday).

The UK possesses one of the fastest corporate registration systems in the world. Because applications are submitted electronically via authorized formation software connected directly to Companies House APIs, manual data entry is eliminated.

2. Express Same-Day Priority Incorporation

If you need your company formed urgently to sign a contract, secure a domain, or open a merchant payment gateway, Companies House offers an Express Same-Day Incorporation Service.

Same-Day Guarantee Rules:

If your application and identity documents are submitted before 3:00 PM UK Time (GMT/BST) on a business day, Companies House guarantees that your Certificate of Incorporation will be issued by 6:00 PM the exact same day.

3. Paper Registration vs Online Digital Filing

It is critical to distinguish between paper application forms (Form IN01 sent by postal mail) and digital electronic submission:

RECOMMENDED

Digital Online Filing

  • Duration: 3 to 24 Hours
  • Digital Certificates sent via PDF instantly
  • Available for Non-UK Residents
AVOID

Postal Paper Filing

  • Duration: 8 to 15 Business Days
  • High risk of postal loss or rejection
  • Requires physical paper signing

4. Step-by-Step Breakdown of Setup Stages

The complete incorporation procedure consists of four distinct operational stages:

Stage 1

KYC Identity Verification (30–60 Minutes)

You submit your passport copy and proof of residential address. ADVAQ's compliance team verifies your documents under UK anti-money laundering (AML) regulations.

Stage 2

Companies House Queueing & Processing (3–24 Hours)

Your application is transmitted directly to the Companies House automated examiner queue.

Stage 3

Certificate & Document Generation (Instant upon Approval)

Upon approval, Companies House issues your Company Registration Number (CRN), Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum, and Articles of Association.

Stage 4

HMRC Corporation Tax Activation & Banking (24–48 Hours)

Your company is registered with HMRC for Corporation Tax, and digital bank applications (Wise Business / Payoneer) are submitted.

5. Common Reasons for Companies House Delays

While 95% of digital incorporations complete in under 24 hours, the following factors can trigger a manual review or rejection:

  • Sensitive Company Names: Words like "Group", "International", "Trust", "Bank", or "Royal" require supporting justification letters, which adds 1–3 business days.
  • Similar Existing Names: If your proposed name is deemed too similar to an existing trademark or registered entity, Companies House will reject the application.
